question:
We use dbt Core to run dbt models on snowflake. But when i am running a model with +, its running all the related and some unrelated components. Assume my components are like this -

src1 --\          --> model_tgt_2  
src2 -->model1-->/-->model4-\
src3 -->model2-->model5 ---->model_tgt_1

src1 and src 2 are used in model1. Then model1 is used to built model_tgt_2, and model4.
src3 is used to build model2, and model5.
And then model4 and model5 are used to build intended model_tgt_1.

When i am running dbt run -s +model_tgt_1, its running model1,model2,model4,model5,model_tgt_2, and model_tgt_1.

My questions are

  • why its running model_tgt_2 when this isnt related in DAG.
  • and if its intended, how can skip running strictly unrelated models.
title: dbt Core run : Run only related Models
answer:
If the DAG is correct I dont see why model_tgt_2 would run. However a couple of things that might help:

  • Use --exclude to ignore any models you dont want to run.
  • Use n+model_tgt_1 to limit the number of levels you reference. Note n can be any number.
